props.headline: The pour-over kettle that holds 92 °C for an hour.
props.body: A gooseneck spout that pours a pencil-thin stream, PID temperature control to one degree, and a counterweighted walnut handle. Pre-order for ₹5,990.

image.alt: A pour-over coffee setup with a gooseneck kettle, dripper and scale

props.heading: Three things a good pour needs

items.title: Exact temperature
items.body: Set 80-100 °C on the base dial; Nimbus holds it within one degree for sixty minutes.

items.title: Control of the stream
items.body: A 6 mm gooseneck outlet with a cut lip, so the flow starts and stops when you do.

items.title: A built-in timer
items.body: Lift the kettle and the base starts timing your brew. Set it down to stop.

items.question: What power does the base need?
items.answer: A regular Indian 6 A socket. The base draws 1200 W while heating and under 5 W while holding temperature.

items.question: Can I use it on a gas stove?
items.answer: The kettle body is induction- and gas-safe, but you lose temperature hold and the timer away from the base.

items.question: When will my order ship?
items.answer: The first 500 kettles ship in the second week of December; you will get a tracking link by email the day yours leaves Peenya.

items.question: How do repairs work?
items.answer: Two-year warranty on the kettle and base. We collect from your door, repair in Bengaluru and send it back within ten days.
